extracted.intended_audience: credentialed sports media (beat writers, broadcasters, photographers) covering NBA teams
extracted.subtask_description: Operational guidance and venue-specific procedures for credentialed media covering NBA teams, including parking, media entrance/will-call locations, directions, and contact points for access arrangements.

rubrics_metrics.name: Media parking location and instructions (76ers example)
rubrics_metrics.description: "MEDIA PARKING: Media members attending 76ers games at the Wells Fargo Center should park in the F lot, located on the 11th Street Side of the Wells Fargo Center."
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Includes specifics about which lot to use (F lot, 11th Street side). Also notes season vs single-game arrangements (see related entries). Use team-provided designated media lots when specified.

rubrics_metrics.name: Season parking pass policy
rubrics_metrics.description: "Season parking passes are issued to local media who cover all home games prior to the start of the season."
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Teams issue season parking passes to local media who commit to covering all home games; this is a prerequisite for season parking. Media should coordinate with team communications in advance to obtain season passes.

rubrics_metrics.name: Advance notice for single-game parking arrangements
rubrics_metrics.description: "Contact 76ers Communications (erikchambliss@76ers.com or willabbamont@76ers.com) at least 24 hours prior to the requested games for single-game parking arrangements."
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Single-game parking requests generally require advance notice (explicitly at least 24 hours in this example). Contact the team's communications/PR staff by email/phone to arrange single-game parking.

rubrics_metrics.name: Media entrance location and entry procedure (credential presentation)
rubrics_metrics.description: "MEDIA ENTRANCE: The media entrance is located on the north side of the Wells Fargo Center and marked as Employee/Press entrance. All media members are asked to have their passes ready to present to security at the entrance. All members are required to enter the building through the press gate."
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Media must use the designated media entrance/press gate and present credentials to security; have passes ready to speed entry. Follow venue-specific instructions about which gate to use.

rubrics_metrics.name: Provide clear driving directions to venues and training facilities
rubrics_metrics.description: Examples: step-by-step highway/exchange directions for reaching Wells Fargo Center and Training Complex (e.g., "Take I-95 North to Broad Street exit..."; "Via I-95/Ben Franklin Bridge – Take I-676/US-30E to the Sixth Street exit...").
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Teams include detailed driving directions from major approaches/bridges. Media should consult these directions for routing and parking approaches; rely on team directions for quickest/approved access to media lots and entrances.

rubrics_metrics.name: Media will-call / will call window location
rubrics_metrics.description: Examples: "WILL CALL WINDOW: Located at the main box office at One Center Court, across from the northwest entrance to Moda Center." and "REGULAR WILL CALL: Northwest Plaza level near corner of Jefferson and 1st Streets."
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Teams specify where media should pick up credentials/will-call. Verify the stated will-call location (box office, plaza level, near TV truck/loading dock) on event day.

rubrics_metrics.name: Venue-specific media parking alternatives and overflow instructions
rubrics_metrics.description: Examples: Phoenix Suns: "MEDIA PARKING: Jefferson Street Parking Garage between 3rd & 4th Streets... Chase Field Parking lot just south of 4th St. & Jackson..." Sacramento Kings: "The first is on the corner of 7th and J under the 24 Hour Fitness. This is the reserved media lot... On L Street just past the arena – between 3rd and 4th – there is a lot with media overflow spaces."
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Teams list primary media lots and overflow parking options. Media should follow specified entrances (e.g., use 3rd Street entrance) and signage, and use overflow lots when primary lots are full.

rubrics_metrics.name: Media entrance & loading-dock/TV-truck access guidance (stadium-specific)
rubrics_metrics.description: Examples: "MEDIA WILL CALL AND ENTRANCE: Located just past the TV truck/loading dock off Drexler Drive, to the left of the security office." and similar venue notes about media entrance proximity to TV truck/loading dock.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Media entrances are often located near TV trucks/loading docks; arrive via the routes recommended to access these points and follow security instructions on arrival.

rubrics_metrics.name: Provide press room contact numbers and fax
rubrics_metrics.description: Headers and lines such as "Press Room:" and "Press Room Fax:" (e.g., Phoenix Suns: Press Room: (602) 514-8254; Press Room Fax: (602) 514-8253).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Teams list press room phone/fax numbers for credential queries or media operations. Media should use these contacts for day-of questions about press room access or logistics.

rubrics_metrics.name: Team communications contact point for media operations
rubrics_metrics.description: Multiple team staff listed with titles and contact details (e.g., 76ers: Erik Chambliss, willabbamont@76ers.com; Suns: Stacey Mitch, smitch@suns.com; Trail Blazers: Natalie King, natalie.king@trailblazers.com).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Teams provide named communications/PR staff for arranging media access, parking, credential issues, and other media-day logistics. Media should contact these individuals for official arrangements and day-of assistance.
